			rn_fp_letter_27_visible = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_flag_pool option = RN_FLAG_POOL_ALL } ROOT = { OR = { check_variable = { rn_fp_view = 2 } has_country_flag = rn_fp_view_other } } }
			rn_fp_letter_27_click_enabled = { ROOT = { NOT = { check_variable = { rn_fp_letter = 27 } } } }
			rn_fp_lt_27_visible = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_flag_pool option = RN_FLAG_POOL_ALL } ROOT = { OR = { check_variable = { rn_fp_view = 2 } has_country_flag = rn_fp_view_other } } ROOT = { NOT = { check_variable = { rn_fp_letter = 27 } } } }
			rn_fp_lta_27_visible = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_flag_pool option = RN_FLAG_POOL_ALL } ROOT = { OR = { check_variable = { rn_fp_view = 2 } has_country_flag = rn_fp_view_other } } ROOT = { check_variable = { rn_fp_letter = 27 } } }
		}
		properties = {
			rn_fp_preview = { image = "GFX_rnf_[?ROOT.rn_fp_sel|0]" }
			rn_fp_cell_flag = { image = "GFX_rnfm_[?rn_fp_v|0]" }
		}
		dynamic_lists = {
			rn_fp_grid = {
				array = ROOT.rn_fp_cells
				value = rn_fp_v
				change_scope = no
				entry_container = "rn_fp_cell"
			}
			rn_fp_rows_grid = {
				array = ROOT.rn_fp_rows
				change_scope = yes
				entry_container = "rn_fp_row"
			}
		}
	}
}
